scheme_name: Aaloo Ke Kufri Chipsona-1 Prabhed Ke Kshetra Vistaar Yojana
other_conditions: Minimum agricultural land required is 0.25 acres (0.1 ha) and maximum is 5 acres (2 ha).
Applicant must be registered on the DBT portal.
Benefits can be taken by ryot farmers based on land documents and by non‑ryot farmers based on a contract form.
Beneficiaries will be selected on a first‑come‑first‑serve basis.
benefits_summary: Farmers receive subsidized high‑quality Kufri Chipsona‑I potato seeds and financial assistance up to ₹93,863 per hectare over two years.
